name: workjet-server-help
stdout:
DESCRIPTION
  Run the Workjet server.

USAGE
  workjet <subcommand> [flags] [<cwd>]

ARGUMENTS
  cwd string    Working directory for provider sessions (defaults to the current directory). (optional)

FLAGS
  --mode choice                              Runtime mode. `desktop` keeps loopback defaults unless overridden. (choices: web, desktop)
  --port integer                             Port for the HTTP/WebSocket server.
  --host string                              Host/interface to bind (for example 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0, or a Tailnet IP).
  --base-dir string                          Explicit Workjet data directory; runtime state is stored under userdata (equivalent to WORKJET_HOME).
  --dev-url string                           Dev web URL to proxy/redirect to (equivalent to VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL).
  --no-browser                               Disable automatic browser opening.
  --bootstrap-fd integer                     Read one-time bootstrap secrets from the given file descriptor.
  --auto-bootstrap-project-from-cwd          Create a project for the current working directory on startup when missing.
  --log-websocket-events, --log-ws-events    Emit server-side logs for outbound WebSocket push traffic (equivalent to WORKJET_LOG_WS_EVENTS).
  --tailscale-serve                          Configure Tailscale Serve to expose this backend over HTTPS on the Tailnet.
  --tailscale-serve-port integer             HTTPS port for Tailscale Serve when --tailscale-serve is enabled.

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                                                          Show help information
  --version, -v                                                       Show version information
  --wizard                                                            Start wizard mode for a command
  --completions <bash|zsh|fish|sh>                                    Print shell completion script (choices: bash, zsh, fish, sh)
  --log-level <all|trace|debug|info|warn|warning|error|fatal|none>    Sets the minimum log level (choices: all, trace, debug, info, warn, warning, error, fatal, none)

SUBCOMMANDS
  start      Run the Workjet server.
  serve      Run the Workjet server without opening a browser and print headless pairing details.
  pair       Mint a pairing token for a running Workjet server and print it as a QR code.
  auth       Manage the local auth control plane for headless deployments.
  project    Manage projects.
  service    Manage the Workjet background service.
publication_note: Secret redaction; unvalidated model IDs/catalogs and unrelated commands omitted. Runtime scripts rediscover selections.
